item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00437","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C04","C03","C02"],"selected_candidate_label":"C04","confidence":0.97,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C04 is a direct predecessor observance for the same November 11 holiday before its renaming from Armistice Day to Veterans Day. It supplies material language and structure reused in the child: the statutory dedication to world peace, an invitation to observe the day by pursuing peace, and the immediately following direction to display the flag on all public buildings. C03 is similarly strong but lacks C04's especially close statutory and invitational phrasing. C02 parallels the flag-display and intergovernmental ceremonial provisions but concerns a different observance and is less distinctive.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"the Congress has designated the eleventh of November as a legal holiday ... and has dedicated it to the cause of world peace","parent_excerpt":"made November 11 of each year a legal holiday, and provided that the day should be dedicated to the cause of world peace","explanation":"Distinctive shared statement of the holiday's date, legal status, and dedication to world peace."},{"child_excerpt":"do hereby invite all our citizens on Saturday, November 11, 1961, to observe Veterans Day ... expressive of our people's desire for peace","parent_excerpt":"do hereby invite and urge the people of the Nation to devote themselves anew on Wednesday, November 11, 1953, to the task of promoting ... a permanent peace","explanation":"Parallel operative invitation to observe November 11 through renewed dedication to peace."},{"child_excerpt":"I also direct the appropriate officials of the Federal Government to arrange for the display of the flag of the United States on all public buildings on Veterans Day.","parent_excerpt":"I also direct the appropriate officials of the Government to arrange for the display of the flag of the United States on all public buildings on that day.","explanation":"Near-verbatim administrative provision appearing in the same operative sequence."}]}
